The King gorges on his court.

She devours her own.

spit.name: Sulphur Spit

coil.name: Coil

miasma_matriarch.name: Miasma Matriarch

ash_penitent.name: Ash Penitent

cinder_hound.name: Cinder Hound

maul.name: Black Maul
maul.text: 7 and 1 Burn to the front hero

censer_deacon.name: Censer Deacon

smoke.text: 1 Erode and 4 stress to every hero

swing.name: Censer Swing
swing.text: 7 and 1 Burn to the front hero

candle_wraith.name: Candle Wraith

gutter.name: Gutter
gutter.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Burn to the rearmost hero

pyre_knight.name: Pyre Knight

unburnt_inquisitor.name: The Unburnt Inquisitor

accuse.text: 14 stress and Mark to the rearmost hero

torch.text: 10 and 3 Burn to the rearmost hero

verdict.name: Verdict

saint_unending.name: The Saint Unending

gear_spider.name: Gear Spider

bite.name: Static Bite
bite.text: 5 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

web.name: Copper Web
web.text: 3 and Anchored to the front hero

gear_spider.lore: It repairs the orrery. It considers you a fault.

aurora_moth.name: Aurora Moth

dust.name: Aurora Dust
dust.text: 1 Static and 1 Weaken to every hero

aurora_moth.lore: Drawn to the frozen stars. Its wings carry the northern lights.

hook.name: Hook and Haul
hook.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

rime_colossus.name: Rime Colossus

freeze.name: Freezing Grip
freeze.text: 8 and 3 Weaken to the front hero

rime_colossus.lore: An ice statue of the founder. Someone wound it up.

frozen_whaler.name: Frozen Whaler

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.text: 8 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

flense.name: Flense
flense.text: 6 and 3 Bleed to the front hero

rime_gulls.name: Rime Gulls

peck.name: Peck the Eyes
peck.text: 2 three times to the rearmost hero

mob.name: Mob
mob.text: 6 stress and Vulnerable to the front hero

ice_eel.name: Ice Eel

bite.name: Frostbite
bite.text: 6 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the front hero

ice_eel.lore: It hunts through holes in the ice.

deck_hand.name: Drowned Deckhand

walrus_brute.name: Walrus Brute

crush.name: Belly Crush
crush.text: 7 and Stun to the front hero

walrus_brute.lore: It hauled out on the ice beside the ships and never left.

icewed_captain.name: The Ice-Wed Captain

lantern.name: Drowned Lantern
lantern.text: 2 Soak and 6 stress to every hero

keelhaul.name: Keelhaul
keelhaul.text: 8 and 2 Weaken to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

icewed_captain.lore: Married to the sea, and the sea froze at the wedding.

frost_selkie.name: Frost Selkie

claw.name: Raking Claws
claw.text: 6 twice and 2 Bleed to the front hero

frost_selkie.lore: She lost her skin to a sailor. She took his in return.

swallow.name: Swallow Whole

freeze.name: White Breath
freeze.text: 2 Weaken and 1 Volatile Soak to every hero

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.text: 12 to the rearmost hero; shoves them back 1

It drags the whole fleet down with it.

barrow_draugr.name: Barrow Draugr

grip.name: Cold Grip
grip.text: 6 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

barrow_draugr.lore: Buried with its axe so it could keep fighting. It does.

plague_wolf.name: Plague Wolf

bite.name: Plague Bite
bite.text: 6 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

plague_wolf.lore: The barrow wolves carry the old plague in their teeth.

frostbit_leper.name: Frostbitten Leper

touch.name: Unclean Touch
touch.text: 5, 2 Toxin and 1 Weaken to the front hero

frostbit_leper.lore: It rings its bell to warn you. You should have listened.

mold_wight.name: Mould Wight

claw.name: Mouldy Claw
claw.text: 7 and 1 Toxin to the rearmost hero

mold_wight.lore: The mould grew a shape in the dark, and the shape grew hungry.

grave_worm.name: Grave Worm

feed.name: Feed
feed.text: 5 and 1 Toxin to the front hero; healing itself

grave_worm.lore: It eats the dead. It has eaten so many that it has started to look like them.

barrow_thane.name: Barrow Thane

rot.name: Rotting Cut
rot.text: 8, 2 Toxin and 2 Weaken to the front hero

barrow_thane.lore: A lord buried with his household. He still keeps them in line.

rot_witch.name: Rot Witch

hex.name: Rot Hex
hex.text: 3 Toxin and 2 Hex to the rearmost hero

frost.name: Frost Nail
frost.text: 8 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

curse.name: Wasting Curse
curse.text: 10 stress and 1 Volatile Toxin to every hero

rot_witch.lore: She keeps the barrow's dead from rotting, and their plague from dying.

winter.name: Long Winter
winter.text: 2 Weaken and 12 stress to every hero

court.name: Summon the Court
court.text: 2 Might and 4 Regen to every foe

hollow_wanderer.name: Hollow Wanderer

empty.name: Emptiness
empty.text: 2 Erode and 4 stress to the front hero

hollow_wanderer.lore: It walks the tundra looking for its face.

silence_stag.name: Silence Stag

stamp.name: Stamp
stamp.text: 6 and Stun to the front hero

silence_stag.lore: It makes no sound when it runs. It makes no sound when it kills.

starless_eye.name: Starless Eye

stare.name: Starless Stare
stare.text: 10 stress and 1 Erode to the rearmost hero

ray.name: Cold Ray
ray.text: 7 and 1 Weaken to the front hero

starless_eye.lore: An eye that fell from the black star. It is still looking for the rest of the face.

frozen_saint.name: Frozen Saint

litany.name: Frozen Litany
litany.text: 6 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

frozen_saint.lore: It prayed for warmth. The black star answered.

reap.name: Reap
reap.text: 9 and 2 Bleed to the front hero

cold.name: Absolute Cold

pale_hunter.name: The Pale Hunter

mark.name: Mark the Prey

claws.name: Rend

void_mammoth.name: Void Mammoth

trumpet.name: Trumpet of the Void
trumpet.text: 12 stress and 1 Erode to every hero

cold_star.name: The Cold Star

zero.name: Absolute Zero

shock_eel.name: Shock Eel

jolt.name: Jolt

storm_harpy.name: Storm Harpy

tide_crab.name: Tide Crab
tide_crab.lore: It picks the wrecks clean. You are a wreck.

drowned_bosun.name: Drowned Bosun

lash.name: Lash
lash.text: 6 and 2 Bleed to the rearmost hero

haul.name: Haul Away
haul.text: 4 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

drowned_bosun.lore: The wreckers' last catch. He signed on.

lighthouse_keeper.name: The Lighthouse Keeper

beam.name: False Beam
beam.text: 10 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

log.name: Ship's Log
log.text: 1 Might and Dodge to every foe

storm.name: Call the Storm
storm.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

lighthouse_keeper.lore: He keeps the light burning in the wrong place.

harpy_matron.name: Harpy Matron

dive.name: Dive from the Storm
dive.text: 14 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

harpy_matron.lore: The mother of the storm harpies, crowned with a drowned queen's circlet.

thunder_whale.name: The Thunder Whale

thunder_whale.lore: The storm on the coast is its song.

sting.name: Sting

fang.name: Venom Fang
fang.text: 6 and 3 Toxin to the front hero

web.name: Web
web.text: 3 and Anchored to the rearmost hero
